boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Rhode Island, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend loop for getting oriented, finding campus resources, and trying recurring ways to connect.

cards.title: Start with the Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: 75 Briar Lane, Kingston
cards.notes: Begin at the campus gateway to get your bearings, then use URI’s directions and map links to choose a simple walking route.
cards.short_summary: An official starting point for navigating Kingston campus.
cards.evidence_claim: URI identifies the Robert J. Higgins Welcome Center as the GPS destination for Kingston campus directions and publishes its visitor hours.
cards.access_notes: URI lists the center as open year-round Monday–Friday, with Saturday academic-year hours; check the official page before visiting.

cards.title: Make the Union your meeting point
cards.subtitle: 50 Lower College Road, Kingston
cards.notes: Use the Union as a central meetup and information stop; its atria and event rooms make it a practical place to check what is happening.
cards.short_summary: A central campus building for programs, services, and meetups.
cards.evidence_claim: URI’s Memorial Student Union page gives the building address and operating information, while University Events lists its gathering and event spaces.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation – Memorial Student Union
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester and break period; confirm the posted schedule before relying on the building being open.

cards.entity_name: Robert L. Carothers Library & Learning Commons
cards.title: Locate the library before you need it
cards.subtitle: 15 Lippitt Road, Kingston
cards.notes: Take a quick walkthrough to spot research help, study areas, and the first-floor study lounge, then save the library hours for later.
cards.short_summary: A study and research stop near the campus core.
cards.evidence_claim: URI’s student guide identifies the Robert L. Carothers Library & Learning Commons at 15 Lippitt Road and describes study areas, research help, and labs.
cards.source_title: Becoming A Ram – URI Inside Rec Blog
cards.access_notes: Library hours change by term; consult the library’s current schedule before making a late study plan.

cards.title: Cross the Quad and notice the landmarks
cards.subtitle: Central green space on URI’s Kingston campus
cards.notes: Walk the perimeter slowly and use the surrounding halls as navigation anchors; return when a campus program or outdoor activity is posted.
cards.short_summary: The central open space linking many academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: URI describes the Quad as a campus landmark near academic halls and notes year-round activities there, including games, club sign-ups, yoga, and food-truck nights.
cards.source_title: Becoming A Ram – URI Inside Rec Blog
cards.access_notes: The outdoor space itself is publicly viewable; individual programs have their own schedules and possible requirements.

cards.title: Plan one uncomplicated meal
cards.subtitle: Top floor of Hope Commons, Kingston campus
cards.notes: Check the menu and meal-period schedule, then choose a time that fits your plan. Ask staff about allergy or sensitivity navigation if needed.
cards.short_summary: An all-you-care-to-eat dining hall in Hope Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Dining identifies Mainfare as an all-you-care-to-eat facility on the top floor of Hope Commons and lists meal plans, cash, and credit cards as accepted.
cards.source_title: Mainfare Dining Hall – URI Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Hours and service periods are posted by URI Dining and may change between terms; payment or a meal-plan swipe is required.

cards.title: Check out the recreation center
cards.subtitle: 18 Butterfield Road, Kingston
cards.notes: Stop by to learn the facility layout and current access rules, then decide whether a workout, class, or wellness resource fits your weekend.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility with fitness and wellness spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: URI says the Anna Fascitelli Fitness and Wellness Center has cardio and strength equipment, group exercise studios, and a Wellness Resource Center.
cards.source_title: Anna Fascitelli Fitness & Wellness Center – URI Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Facility hours, closures, and membership or guest-access rules vary; verify them on URI Campus Recreation before entering.

cards.title: Look for an arts listing
cards.subtitle: URI Kingston campus
cards.notes: Check the current calendar for a concert, gallery program, or performance, and use the listing’s details instead of assuming admission or seating.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue for theatre, music, and visual-arts programming.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists the Fine Arts Center as a Kingston campus venue with the Robert E. Will Theatre, J Studio Theatre, and G Studio.
cards.source_title: Kingston Campus Venues – URI Office of University Events
cards.access_notes: Entry and cost depend on the specific event; consult the current URI event listing before going.

cards.title: Try a student organization fair
cards.subtitle: Recurring campus involvement activity
cards.notes: If a fair is on the calendar, make one lap before committing to anything. Ask groups about meeting cadence, beginner access, and contact details.
cards.short_summary: A recurring chance to meet campus organizations and learn how to join.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Student Involvement says student organization fairs occur each semester and connect students with campus organizations and ways to get involved.
cards.source_title: Traditions and Events – URI Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: This is a recurring semester activity, not a guaranteed first-weekend event; check the current Student Involvement calendar.

cards.title: Save RhodyFest as a welcome-week option
cards.subtitle: URI first-year welcome activity
cards.notes: When it appears on the calendar, use it to sample activities and speak with student organizations; treat the evening trivia component as an optional stop.
cards.short_summary: A documented URI welcome event for incoming first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: URI describes RhodyFest as a welcome for incoming first-year students with free food, activities, student organizations, and a Memorial Union trivia competition.
cards.source_title: Traditions and Events – URI Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: RhodyFest is a scheduled welcome event rather than an always-available venue; confirm the date, location, and attendance details with Student Involvement.

cards.title: Watch for Beats & Eats
cards.subtitle: Monthly URI Student Involvement activity
cards.notes: Check whether a monthly session is scheduled, then arrive while supplies last if you want the food-truck voucher and giveaway alongside WRIU music.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Student Involvement describes Beats & Eats as a monthly event with music by WRIU, a food truck, a free voucher while supplies last, and a giveaway item.
cards.source_title: Traditions and Events – URI Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: Availability and supplies are event-specific; verify the current listing and do not assume a voucher will be available.
